shortIntro.title: Can Your Phone Handle Shadow Fight 3? ⚔️📱
shortIntro.para1: Shadow Fight 3 is not just another tap-to-fight game. It features realistic physics, detailed 3D animations, dynamic lighting, and weapon-based combat that push mobile hardware harder than you think.
shortIntro.para2: If your device struggles with RAM or GPU power, you may experience frame drops during intense combos or boss fights. Let’s check whether your phone is ready for smooth martial arts action 😎.

faqIntroText: Frequently asked Shadow Fight 3 system requirement questions:

faqList.question: Does Shadow Fight 3 require a high-end phone?
faqList.answer: No. It runs on mid-range devices, but 4GB RAM or higher ensures smoother combat and fewer frame drops.

faqList.question: Can Shadow Fight 3 run on 2GB RAM?
faqList.answer: Yes, but expect lower graphics settings and occasional lag during intense fights.

faqList.question: Is Shadow Fight 3 offline?
faqList.answer: Story mode can be played offline, but events, duels, and cloud saves require an internet connection.
